connector.name: WalletTriage
connector.registryDescription: Real-time exploit-exposure risk check for EVM wallets, paid per query via x402 (USDC on Base).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package wallettriage-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wallettriage account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Private key (0x + 64 hex) of a dedicated low-balance session wallet that signs gasless x402 USDC payments on Base. Never use your main key.

env.name: GATEWAY_URL
env.description: WalletTriage API base URL. Defaults to the public production gateway; set to http://localhost:4021 for local development.

env.name: MAX_PAYMENT_ATOMIC
env.description: Safety cap: refuse any x402 payment requirement above this many atomic USDC units (6 decimals). Default 100000 = US$0.10.

env.name: DEFAULT_SCAN_CHAIN
env.description: Default chain when the caller omits one: eth, base, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, bsc.
